task: Trajectory-preserving feature selection on single-cell readouts
input: adata_RPE.h5ad (4i protein imaging of RPE cells; 2759 cells x 241 features)
output: subset of dynamically expressed molecular features that preserve continuous cellular trajectory
named_methods: DELVE-style dynamic feature selection (graph-smooth dynamic features)
Diffusion pseudotime / DiffMap (Scanpy) for trajectory recovery
evaluation_axes: Spearman correlation between recovered pseudotime and annotated_age
